title: phyllorkis rolfei
intro: Phyllorkis rolfei, commonly known as the yellow-flowered orchid, is a rare and endemic species of orchid found in the Western Ghats of India. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and aiding in the treatment of fever and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Phyllorkis rolfei include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Phyllorkis rolfei include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
